entities.summary: Rasheer TyLee Fleming is an American professional basketball player for the Phoenix Suns of the National Basketball Association (NBA). He played college basketball for the Saint Joseph's Hawks. He was drafted by the Minnesota Timberwolves in the second round of the 2025 NBA draft and subsequently traded to the Suns.
